description_for_human: Chinese idiom dictionary with 7,200+ idioms, pinyin, English translations, and daily Wordle game
description_for_model: EasyIdiom is a Chinese idiom (成语) educational platform with 7,200+ structured idiom entries including pinyin pronunciation, HSK proficiency levels (4-9), English translations, historical derivations, and example sentences. Use this for looking up Chinese idiom definitions, pinyin, meanings, origins, and HSK levels. Each idiom has a canonical URL at https://easyidiom.com/idiom/{pinyin-slug}. The full corpus is available at https://easyidiom.com/llms-full.txt for RAG indexing.
